mapper.sql: p.id, p.title, p.description, p.price, p.original_price, p.cover, p.condition_level, p.status, p.view_count, p.favorite_count, p.create_time, p.category_id, c.name AS category_name, p.seller_id, u.nickname AS seller_nickname, u.avatar AS seller_avatar, u.campus AS seller_campus, u.credit_score AS seller_credit_score
FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = p.seller_id
